content.text: The `queue_name` helper now has a pointless `Ok(...?)` wrapper, so I'll simplify it.

input.command:
python3 - <<'E'
p='src/broker/queue_commands.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''    params.require(&["QueueName"])?;
    Ok(params.required_string("QueueName")?)''','''    params.required_string("QueueName")''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
cargo fmt && cargo clippy --all-targets 2>&1 | grep -E -A5 'warning|error'; cargo test 2>&1 | grep -cE 'test result: ok' ; git commit -qam "Read required parameters through Params instead of expect(\"required\")

Each handler called require() and then unwrapped the typed getter with
a message that only held because of the earlier call. The getters now
report the missing parameter themselves, so the invariant lives in one
place and the duplicate \"is required\" error is gone.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && echo ok
